description: Ports - Normandie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Normandie. The ports of Normandy The data does not fall within the scope of the Inspire Directive. Coverage: Région Normandie. The portal shows the English title as "Ports — Normandy" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Normandie. Its keywords include transports-maritimes, donnees-regionales-de-reference, equipements-de-transport, donnees-ouvertes, mobilites, transports. The listing shows 3 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2022-10-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
